description: The invariant block added to unknown_capability_with_detail matches the pattern established by limit(). Both document: (1) what field carries the payload, (2) which HTTP layer reads that field and why, (3) the consequence of bypassing the constructor. A contributor might simplify the doc by removing the invariant block to reduce length — this block should be defended as it prevents silent misuse by callers who directly construct JmapError structs.
title: invariant doc on unknown_capability_with_detail mirrors the limit() pattern correctly
